integrity_note: Analytic proof uses exact polar vertex classification, mixed-area identities and zonoid approximation; finite arithmetic tests supplement, not replace, proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp zonoid-test (centrally symmetric auxiliary bodies) coefficient only; does not claim unrestricted test-body coefficient, nontrapezoid quadrilaterals, or higher dimensions. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Sharp zonoid-test Bézout coefficients for every planar trapezoid
